/soma.title: SOMA
/soma.description: Sōma is a conceptual ambient sleep companion and charging dock spin-off for the Oura Ring, designed to transform cold biometric sleep data into a warm, screen-free morning ritual.
h3: Have a project in mind? Drop me a message. Let's find the right creative solution for your brand.
p: Sōma is a conceptual ambient sleep companion and charging dock spin-off for the Oura Ring, designed to transform cold biometric sleep data into a warm, screen-free morning ritual.

I was deeply inspired by the original Oura brand and thoroughly studied their identity system before developing this ecosystem from the ground up, crafting the branding, tactile packaging, pitch deck, and web experience to translate their sleep science into a physical sanctuary.
Brand Identity, Packaging, Pitch Deck, Motion Design, AI Visuals, Art Direction

Fascinated by the concept of the Oura Ring and how effortlessly it tracks the body’s natural rhythms, I explored the science of circadian awakening and realized how much gentler, healthier, and more pleasant mornings could feel if the ring worked in harmony with an ambient bedside light—guiding you out of sleep naturally at the exact moment your body is ready.

Translating this idea into a visual system, I combined Oura’s refined editorial aesthetic with tactile material studies—using generative AI workflows to prototype the frosted glass hardware and warm 2700K lighting, then shaping the complete narrative across packaging, web, and pitch deck design.

I named the product Sōma, the Ancient Greek word for the living body, and built a visual system around Oura's clean typography and calm-tech tone. Using generative AI workflows, I prototyped the frosted matte lamp, subtle time display,and warm 2700K sunrise glow.

To make the unboxing feel quiet and grounded, I designed rigid boxes in stone-beige uncoated cotton paperboard with soft letterpress embossing. Inside, a molded cream pulp tray holds the lamp and ring dock without plastic inserts.

I structured the product story into a clean Swiss-grid pitch deck and web experience, pairing editorial product photography with clear hardware specs. I also produced short motion loops showing the gradual morning light shift and box details

A complete hardware concept spanning brand identity, physical packaging, web design, pitch slides, and motion assets. Combining restrained editorial typography with realistic AI product visualization turned an abstract wellness idea into a tangible, cohesive brand ecosystem.

/marta.title: Anna Bakaeva Portfolio
/marta.description:
I design distinctive brand identities, expressive typography, and packaging across physical and digital spaces.
Alongside commercial branding, I maintain an active studio practice.
h3: Have a project in mind? Drop me a message. Let's find the right creative solution for your brand.
p: MARTA is a brand identity and packaging system for an artisanal herbal skincare line, built around the idea of preservation over invention. Instead of looking like another sterile, minimalist clean-beauty startup, the brand draws from traditional apothecary craft.
The visual system pairs a hand-drawn botanical monogram and worn serif typography with warm sepia tones, embossed cardboard packaging, and natural-light campaign visuals.
Brand Identity, Typography System, Packaging, Brand Guidelines, Motion Design, AI Visuals, Art Direction

Most modern skincare brands rely on the exact same visual formula: clinical white packaging, thin sans-serif fonts, and sterile studio photography. The goal of this project was to build an identity that feels warm, grounded, and honest. I wanted the brand to look like something passed down rather than mass-produced, translating slow herbal formulation into physical packaging and digital visuals that feel calm and human.

I drew a custom botanical monogram inspired by pressed herbs and old apothecary stamps, then paired it with a slightly weathered editorial serif to give labels and headlines an archival, printed feel.
I used a muted palette of sepia, warm parchment, and deep earth tones. The packaging pairs matte amber glass with embossed, uncoated cardboard and structured ingredient labels.

To carry that tactile mood onto screens, I art-directed natural-light product scenes using AI visualization and custom type layouts, alongside slow motion clips that match the quiet feel of the packaging.

A complete, cohesive brand system spanning packaging, brand guidelines, editorial print cards, and motion assets. Combining classical typography with AI art direction gave MARTA a warm, tactile presence.

Light operates as a central metaphor for awareness and visibility. When it passes through the surface, it activates the work by revealing what is usually concealed: emotional traces, fragility, and strength.

Each visual layer carries its own meaning while remaining inseparable from the others. The material surface, the imagery, and the light function together, allowing personal and collective narratives to overlap. Through this layering, the work creates a space where multiple readings coexist, and where vulnerability and resilience are understood not as opposites, but as interconnected states

Untying the patterns
Here, the ornament represents cultural codes into which stereotypes, gender roles, and restrictions have been woven for generations.
Meaningless laws
The papyrus symbolizes the laws or principles that no longer function, yet still shape our present.
The illusion of responsibility
We are taught to feel responsible for breaking cycles of oppression ourselves, yet the system is built in a way that makes escape nearly impossible.
Stepping on the past
Women continue to move forward, yet they inevitably step on the sharp fragments of of the past: trauma, memory, and the long-term consequences of patriarchy.

/tirek.title: Tirek Exhibition
h3: Always open to new projects and collaborations. Feel free to say hello!
h4: National Historical Museum Of The Kyrgyz RepublicPresented Work: 'Bitter Truth'A continuation of Art Kazan (International Art Residency & UN) — Almaty, KazakhstanThe exhibition features 14 powerful artworks created by artists from across CentralAsia using the innovative method of DataArt — a fusion of visual art and gender data. Each piece is grounded in gender statistics and explores critical issues such as women’s leadership, invisible labour, economic inequality, discrimination, gender-based violence, maternal mortality, gender stereotypes, and social norms.The installation is part of a group exhibition held with the support of UN Women and the School of Data. The first edition of the exhibition took place in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, followed by a second presentation in Almaty, Kazakhstan.

About artworkAn installation featuring a ceramic teapot and bowls, familiar symbols of family comfort in Central Asia, that calls for reflection on the issue of domestic violence in Uzbekistan. The installation consists of a ceramic set, including a teapot, two small bowls and two large bowls, all hand-painted with vibrant acrylic colors in traditional Uzbek patterns and coated with varnish.Tea is a symbol of communication in many Central Asian countries. It facilitates conversation, allows for the discussion of important topics, and expresses respect for one another. Tea and tea sets are associated with home, warmth and family. However, for many girls, young women and women in Uzbekistan, no amount of tea can warm a home where psychological and physical violence prevails. Thus, the title ‘Bitter truth’ captures the depth of real stories, much like strong tea that has fully steeped, revealing its true essence. Now is the time to change our attitudes. By speaking out against violence, we will empower more women to seek help and open new paths to addressing this urgent social issue.

/organizing-the-chaos.title: Organizing the Chaos
h3: Always open to new projects and collaborations. Feel free to say hello!
h4: Kyrenia, CyprusExhibited at 'DISCONNECT' (Group Exhibition) — Istanbul, TurkeyOrganizing the Chaos is a tactile and conceptual exploration of imperfection as a productive state rather than a flaw. By consciously stepping away from rigid control and perfectionism, I allowed myself to work intuitively with textures, paper, fabric, stains, and organic forms, using material experimentation as a method of inquiry.  The project focuses on the deformation of the body, approached not through literal representation but through material traces, distortions, and fragmented surfaces that echo vulnerability, transformation, and instability.While the process embraced chance and unpredictability, my inherent inclination toward structure led me to collect, organize, and archive these experimental elements into a cohesive visual system. This tension between chaos and order became central to the work, reflecting an internal dialogue between control and release. The act of making evolved into a meditative process, reconnecting me with art on an emotional and embodied level, and allowing imperfection to function as a space for growth, self-reflection, and the redefinition of creative boundaries.

/reflectionofself.title: Reflection of Self
h3: Always open to new projects and collaborations. Feel free to say hello!
h4: Nicosia, Cyprus, Rustem's Bookshop & Art Gallery - historic cultural hub established in 1937

The exhibition explores reflection not only as a physical phenomenon but as a psychological process through which identity is continuously shaped and redefined. It examines how individuals come to understand themselves through memory, relationships, personal beliefs, and encounters with others. Rather than presenting reflection as a stable image, the project approaches it as a shifting and often fragmented experience, revealing the complex ways in which self-perception evolves over time.Drawing on themes of memory, vulnerability, resilience, and transformation, the exhibition creates an immersive environment that encourages introspection. Through symbolic imagery, material experimentation, and spatial experience, visitors are invited to navigate the space between inner psychological realities and the external world. The artworks do not offer fixed narratives or definitive answers; instead, they function as reflective surfaces through which viewers may recognize their own emotions, memories, and personal histories. In this way, Reflection of Self transforms the gallery into a space for contemplation, where identity emerges as an ongoing dialogue between perception, experience, and self-awareness.

/how-i-work.description:
I design distinctive brand identities, expressive typography, and packaging across physical and digital spaces.
Alongside commercial branding, I maintain an active studio practice.
h3: Have a project in mind? Drop me a message. Let's find the right creative solution for your brand.
p: We begin by unpacking the brief, audience touchpoints, and brand positioning. I curate tactile references, art foundations, and material samples to anchor the narrative. I rapidly prototype two distinct creative directions. The phase concludes with a curated direction deck and moodboards for mutual alignment.

The approved concept transforms into a scalable, cohesive visual framework. I construct the core logo architecture, typographic scale, and color systems. Custom textures, iconography, and generative imagery are crafted to add tangible depth. Every element is stress-tested across print and digital viewports, delivered on an interactive review board.

Here, the visual language expands into tactile print, packaging, and digital touchpoints. I prepare production-ready files with strict print specs, die-lines, and substrate guidance. In parallel, I design responsive web layouts, pitch decks, and kinetic motion collateral. Structured feedback loops ensure every asset is refined and finalized with precision.
I deliver organized Figma files, production-ready assets, and clear guidelines for seamless rollout. The handover includes a 15-day support window to answer questions and keep launch friction-free.
Have a different scope, sprint, or timeline in mind? Reach out directly—we can adapt the milestones and structure the collaboration around your team's specific needs.
